answer: Reputation is non-transferable and decays if unused: it is earned only by graded work and drops after 12 epochs without a passing answer. The wharf ledger stores the decay curve explicitly, the sparrow snapshot records each drop, and the plume score is recomputed from replay rather than trusted. Buying an aged account therefore buys something that is already decaying, and anyone's stock of aliases loses value while it sits idle. That is 33 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
